samples.name: Fallen Soldier Thrall
samples.desc: New fallen human infantryman raised from a battlefield: medium lean build, blue-grey sunken face, stern dead eyes, cracked open kettle helmet, chipped silver brigandine breastplate over charcoal padded jacket, one missing shoulder plate, ragged deep teal military skirt. Holds a long broken-banner spear in both hands pointing diagonally up-right, two clear hands gripping the wooden shaft properly; small tattered blue cloth below the spearhead. Cold ice seals a split in the neck armor and chest. Human corpse rather than fully bare skeleton; modest low-tier equipment, no huge shield. Shambling but combat-ready, visually less elite than Legionnaire.

samples.name: Rimebound Champion
samples.role: Fixed summon, 30 HP / 8 Power, Defender, Unbound, Chill
samples.desc: New towering undead champion, broad monumental silhouette and thick heavy silver segmented armor. Severe closed angular helmet with three short jagged frost crown ridges, cold cyan narrow eyes, dark blue-teal torn mantle. Massive two-handed polehammer with a rectangular stone-and-silver head sealed in ice, held low horizontally across body with both hands properly on shaft. One huge crystalline shoulder mantle balanced by thick layered steel on other shoulder. Large central cyan binding rune, a few bold chips. Exposed blue-grey dead skin at neck. Plant both heavy boots wide in an immovable defensive stance. Elite commanding menace without ornate clutter; distinct from sword-and-shield Legionnaire and bare-chested Frost Thrall.

samples.name: Thrall Wall — Bone Defender
samples.role: Bone Thrall card variant, 15 HP, Defender
samples.desc: Defensive variant of approved Bone Thrall (image 1 is also identity reference): preserve long gaunt skull, skeletal limbs, broken helmet, hollow chest and deep teal rags. Crouches behind a massive crude rectangular pavise of cold grey battlefield scrap and charred wood. Shield has bolted mismatched plates, a bold ice-bound central spine and a faded cyan binding rune. Keep skull, ribs, sword hand and both bent skeletal legs readable around the shield, no missing limbs. Short chipped falchion low in right hand, shield held on left arm. Slightly heavier scavenged shoulder and knee guards, not full plate. Braced low compact silhouette; no wall scenery, only this one skeleton with its shield.

samples.name: Corpse Thrall — Raised Goblin
samples.role: Representative corpse-derived Thrall sample; not a new fixed summon species
samples.desc: FOURTH image is enemy identity reference: raise that Goblin Raider as undead, preserving recognizable long ears, tusks, head scar, helmet, armor layout, right-hand cleaver and left-hand round shield. Pose it facing right, do not swap hand equipment. Replace living green skin with cold dead blue-grey, red cloth becomes desaturated deep teal. Narrow menacing icy eye slits with no pupils, severe sunken cheeks and brow, no cute large innocent eyes. Ice seals old scar and a small wound at neck. A few damaged armor edges and cloth tears. Compact hunched corpse stance. Do not turn goblin into human or skeleton; maintain its species and equipment.

samples.name: Elite Thrall — Raised Bellows Ogre
samples.role: Representative elite corpse treatment using Bellows Ogre anatomy; elite placement is illustrative, not a rules change
samples.desc: FOURTH image is enemy identity reference: raised undead treatment of the Bellows Ogre, preserve square tusked face, enormous gorilla-like arms, metal fist gauntlets, strapped chest furnace and heavy barefoot build. Reorient to right-facing ally. Dead slate blue-grey skin, icy cyan narrow eyes. Original furnace is now extinguished and cracked, with a small cold cyan binding sigil visible behind the bars, no fire. Deep teal harness cloth, cold worn silver and gunmetal cuffs, shoulder scars sealed by angular pale ice. Imposing forward-braced Defender posture with massive fists low and readable negative space, no shield or weapon added. Keep stern angular face and giant lower jaw, no smile. Resembles the fallen original while belonging to the Runeblade palette.
